description: Live Base mainnet gas: EIP-1559 base fee, low/medium/high priority fees in gwei, the cost of a transaction in USD, ETH and gwei, and ready-to-sign maxFeePerGas / maxPriorityFeePerGas. Costs about $0.002. Each call makes a real USDC micropayment on Base mainnet via x402 from BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY; payments above MAX_USD_PER_CALL are refused. Do not call it in loops.

gasLimit.description: Gas units to price. 21000 ETH transfer (default), ~65000 ERC-20 transfer, ~85000 NFT mint, ~180000 Uniswap swap, ~1500000 contract deploy.
